description: Angular component for entity view page in Thingsboard UI, managing entity data, form building, and user interactions.

classes.name: EntityViewComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending EntityComponent to display and manage entity views, including form handling and user interactions.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, sets entity view scope, and subscribes to form value changes.

methods.name: hideDelete
methods.description: Determines if delete option should be hidden based on configuration.

methods.name: isAssignedToCustomer
methods.description: Checks if the entity is assigned to a customer by comparing customerId against NULL_UUID.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Constructs a reactive form group for entity data.

methods.name: updateForm
methods.description: Updates form values with provided entity data.

methods.name: onEntityViewIdCopied
methods.description: Dispatches notification when entity view ID is copied.
